methods.label: Establish that the triangle is equilateral
methods.explanation: \(\angle C=\angle B=60^\circ\), and \(\angle A=60^\circ\). The triangle is equilateral, so its perimeter is \(3\times5=15\).
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 8 isosceles base angles, the angle sum, and the equilateral-triangle criterion.
